item.tib: sangs rgyas bstan pa'i byung khungs lo rgyus snang ba dkar po'i dpal
item.coloph: grub mtha' de ba d+ha ri'i tshal chen nas/ lo rgyus rnam dag dpyid kyi dpal mo'i glu/ thar 'dod rna ba'i gsos su babs pa'i tshe/ dga' spro'i dang kha bde byed 'di kho na// rnam 'dren rgyal ba gshen gyi bstan pa la/ dad mos gus pa'i nus shugs cher bskyed de/ lung las rig pas phyes te bkod yod kyi/ rang bzhin rmongs dang thos cha phra ba'i rkyen/ nor 'khrul mchis na bslu med tshogs la bshags/ bsam dang sbyor ba rnam dag las smin pa'i/ rnam dkar mchis gtsos dus gsum dge rtsa kun/ mkha' mnyam 'gro kun bla med byang chub phyir/ 'khor gsum rnam dag dmigs med klong du bsngo/ 'di mthus g.yung drung bon bstan rin po che/ phyogs bcu kun du dar khyab rgyas gyur cig der brten bde chen snying pos khyab tshad kun/ byang grol bde chen dpal la 'khod gyur cig thar lam grub mtha'i rnam thar phra mo 'di/ sde snod zung gsum ya drug gsog pa'i snod/ khug rul rnying pa'i mthil nas gsar rnyed 'di/ rgyal gshen ring lugs rtag brtan rgyur gyur cig/
